raw_feedback.comment: During your HPI you let the patient finish describing triggers before redirecting, which improved clarity. Your summary highlighted onset, duration, and positional component. Next time, add one sentence explaining why BPPV is most likely and what would shift you toward vestibular migraine.

Strong structure: 1-liner then top problems then plan. You used teach-back at the end and the patient accurately repeated the plan. For growth: state 1 alternative diagnosis and one key discriminating question.

cases.learner_reflection: I felt better organized today and tried to slow down my closing instructions.
